newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel Chemicals Q4 net $12.6 million.
newsitem.headline: Israel Chemicals Q4 net $12.6 million.

text.p: Earnings per Share n/a n/a 0.058 Loss-0.021

ICL, a holding company, said the improvement in 1996 earnings was due to the company's cost-cutting measures, higher prices for most of its products and the inclusion of earnings of companies acquired over the year that do not appear in the 1995 results.
During 1996, ICL group companies acquired the U.S. company Clearon and the German company B.K. Ladenburg. ICL said discounting newly acquired companies, revenues rose only 2.7 percent last year.

The company added that a major contributing factor to the turnaround was ICL's Fertilisers and Chemicals Ltd unit, which broke even last year after a $64.1 million 1995 loss. The 1995 loss was due to charges taken against a restructuring programme.
ICL said sales from its chemical businesses rose 27 percent in 1996 causing operating profit to double to $85.3 million. Operating margins rose to 8.9 percent from 5.6 percent.
Fertiliser sales rose 11.8 percent to $622.6 million while operating profit grew 14.9 percent to $89 million, the company said.
